fields.value: Relay storage-held run inputs to storage-less machines

Found by MTG-175 (manabot), 2026-10-30; Jack Heart chose an Etude fix over re-registering the mini.

Problem (etude-sdk 0.2.12, shared controller): an input that is another run's file ([Input.run](<http://Input.run>)) reaches a machine only via Scheduler.\_relay/\_carry, which copies from the holding machine's disk. When the holder kept its records in storage (a RunPod pod with r2), Execution.held returns None, nothing is relayed, and an SSH machine registered without storage (machine 'mini', storage=None) fails source preparation with 'input ... was not delivered: ... this machine has neither storage nor the file'. The attempt is lost before gameplay and retried until attempts are exhausted. On the shared launcher 69 such mini attempts were lost; none started.

Outcome: a storage-less machine receives a run-file input held in storage — the controller (which holds storage credentials) reads the verified bytes from storage and relays them with hold(), or an equivalent supported path — with digest verification unchanged and nothing silently skipped. Add a regression test covering RunPod-with-storage holder -> SSH-without-storage consumer. Repeated failures of this kind should surface as a clear cause rather than burning all attempts.

Constraints: preserve the schema-11 database and existing run identities; any release needs a coordinated controller upgrade with MTG-183 (manabot), which owns the shared controller (launchd gg.manabot.mtg183.controller, env \~/.manabot/etude-controller). MTG-175 has 23 lost CPU evals to resubmit once fixed. Don't induce load in tests.
